verse.verse_1: When the earth is shaken by the shaking thereof,
verse.verse_2: And the earth bringeth forth her burthens,
verse.verse_3: And man saith: what aileth her?
verse.verse_4: On that Day she will tell out the tidings thereof.
verse.verse_5: Because thy Lord will inspire her.
verse.verse_6: On that Day mankind will proceed in bands, that they may be shewn their works.
verse.verse_7: Then whosoever hath worked good of an atom's weight shall behold it
verse.verse_8: And whosoever hath worked ill Of an atom's weight shall behold it.
